claim: Groups link transitively, and a bird exactly 4.5 away is not linked.
derivation: Five birds on the line y = 16: A x = 2, B 6, C 10, D 14, E 18.5. Every velocity points along (0.6, 0.8), so the mean heading has length 1: directionalAgreement = 1 (E12).
Consecutive gaps A–B, B–C and C–D are 4; D–E is exactly 4.5; E to A is 15.5 the short way round (E1).
Nearest distances are 4, 4, 4, 4 and 4.5, so meanNeighbourDistance = 20.5/5 = 4.1 (E13).
Links need a distance strictly below 4.5 (E14): A, B, C and D form one chain although A and D are 12 apart, and E stays alone, so clusterCount = 2.
